name: Example: Replays
author: byo-pop examples
description: Every game is recorded as it is played. The game-over screen gets WATCH REPLAY, and Extras (in Options) a browser of the recent replays, which plays any of them back exactly. Changes nothing in play.

settings.label: Replays kept
settings.help: The newest games kept in the replay folder; older ones go. Replays you Keep in the browser stay.

settings.label: Record the mouse
settings.help: Also records where the mouse moved, so a replay shows the hover glow on gems. Makes the files larger.
